<a id="document-example-theme-site-json"></a>
### theme/site.json

From [`theme/site.json`](../STARTER.md). It is a site's manifest (`site.json`), not a page. It is written as JSON:

```json
{
  "schema": 3,
  "pages": [
    "home.json"
  ],
  "theme": {
    "primary": "ember",
    "onPrimary": "paper",
    "colors": {
      "ink": "#FF1B1B1B",
      "ember": "#FFE4572E",
      "paper": "#FFF6F1E9"
    },
    "textStyles": {
      "body": {
        "fontSize": 16,
        "height": 1.5,
        "color": "ink"
      },
      "title": {
        "from": "body",
        "fontSize": 32,
        "fontWeight": 700,
        "height": 1.2
      },
      "eyebrow": {
        "from": "body",
        "fontSize": 12,
        "letterSpacing": 2,
        "color": "ember"
      }
    },
    "media": [
      {
        "minWidth": 1024,
        "patch": {
          "textStyles": {
            "title": {
              "fontSize": 56
            }
          }
        }
      }
    ]
  }
}
```
